_notes: What UQM 0.8.0's own starbase screens draw, recorded by running its DoStarBase and DoOutfit (with sis.c, menu.c, border.c and util.c's drawing) with each drawing call recorded in the screen's coordinates (tools/extract/golden/screens.c), on a clock of the program's own; the frames counted from the official content package (SHA-256 77d75ac25e6fb755a33c4ba3b38a7b7bc41fcbc02896891b0cc9ac9214b72eef), the fonts by their leading.

Each scenario: as outfit.json's (the story state, prices, ship), and the steps (base:S opens the menu on entry S, outfit opens outfitting, t:N runs the screen at the clock's N with no key, the rest keys), with what each drew: ["s", resource, frame, x, y] a stamp, ["f", resource, frame, x, y, r, g, b] a filled stamp, ["r"/"o"/"c", x, y, width, height, r, g, b] a filled rectangle, an outline, the clip rectangle cleared, ["p", x, y, r, g, b] a point, ["t", font, x, y, align, count, text, r, g, b, effect] text ({gs:N} is GAME_STRING (N); effect the font effect's frame of graphics.fontgradient, or -1).
